The test image shows the underside of a leaf with diffuse yellow-orange powdery patches/lesions against a pale green background. This strongly suggests Rust disease.

Let me view one Rust reference image to confirm.

The reference Rust image is a near-identical match to the test image: same pale underside of a leaf, same diffuse yellow-orange powdery lesions scattered across the surface. This is classic coffee leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix) — orange/yellow uredinia erupting through stomata on the lower leaf surface.
